entities.summary: Jonathan Barreiro Rodríguez is a Spanish professional basketball player for Unicaja in the Liga ACB. During the 2013–14 season, at just 17 years old, he made his debut in the Liga ACB and the EuroLeague with the Real Madrid first team.
